sources.title: Latitude Equinox-31B takes on generic AI in gaming
sources.snippet: Latitude's Equinox-31B release is a small but useful test for AI gaming. Generic chatbots can produce text, but games need models that hold tension, remember tone, and let a story become uncomfortable without falling out of character.
